about: The platform shifts that could make a SecuRAX product obsolete (doc 108). Review each every quarter: what changed, and what SecuRAX does about it. ./securax venture guards fails when a review is older than 92 days. Cannibalise yourself before someone else does.

shifts.shift: AI agents doing first-line SOC work inside the big platforms (Microsoft, Google, CrowdStrike)
shifts.response: Integrate with them (connectors), do not race them; sell the regulator clock, evidence and India depth they lack

shifts.shift: AI security bundled into suites (Palo Alto bought Protect AI; Check Point is buying Lakera)
shifts.response: Compete on offline use, India-aware redaction and residency, open code; keep Shield cheap to adopt next to a suite

shifts.shift: Regulators or exchanges offering their own compliance or SOC services (NSE/BSE Market SOC)
shifts.response: Feed them: export to the formats they ask for; serve the entities and auditors they do not cover

shifts.shift: Post-quantum standards and browser support moving fast
shifts.response: Keep the CBOM and the map current with each NIST and CERT-In step; sell the plan, not the scare

shifts.shift: Small local models good enough for most work
shifts.response: An opportunity: the ladder already ends on a local model; make offline the default story

shifts.shift: Global GRC platforms adding Indian frameworks and AI assessments
shifts.response: Stay deeper and faster on Indian rules (paragraph level, by chapter); partner with auditors they do not reach
